storyBible.title: A Market for Hearts
storyBible.logline: In a rain-soaked, neon-lit London, a billionaire shunned by a spirited market girl disguises himself as a nobody to win her trust, only to face the truth that love cannot outwit betrayal.
storyBible.ending: Ethan’s true identity is revealed to Lily just as his company threatens her world, shattering everything between them and leaving their future uncertain.
storyBible.tone: Yearning, atmospheric, bittersweet, pulsing with tension and vulnerable humor.

unchangingFacts: Ethan is secretly the billionaire owner of the company threatening Lily's market.
Lily runs her stall alone, fiercely protective of her late father’s memory.
The story must play out in rain-soaked, contemporary, cyberpunk-styled but realistic London.
No overt sci-fi elements—only visual atmosphere nods to cyberpunk.
Only three speaking characters: Ethan/Jack, Lily, Harrison.

outline.events: A black Rolls-Royce halts by the neon-lit curb. Ethan steps out, instantly drawing every gaze in the market. His navy suit gleams under streetlights as raindrops slide off. All movement slows as he surveys the crowd. He locks eyes with Lily briefly across the chaos, her expression unreadable as she weighs fruit.
outline.keyDialogue: Narration (V.O.): "He could buy anything in London. Buildings. Companies. People. But there was one thing his billions couldn't buy... a girl selling tomatoes for a pound."
outline.outfits: Ethan: o1 (navy suit); Lily: o1 (market jacket); Harrison: not present.
outline.emotionalShift: Curiosity and longing spark in Ethan; Lily remains unimpressed amid the spectacle.
outline.endingHook: Ethan heads toward Lily’s stall, intent clear in his eyes.

outline.setting: Lily’s tomato stall, rain pouring, neon flickering.
outline.events: Lily shouts prices to passersby, brushing soggy hair from her eyes. Ethan approaches, picks up a tomato—studying it intensely. She raises an eyebrow, unimpressed by his presence.
outline.keyDialogue:
Lily: "It's a tomato, not a diamond. Buy it or put it down."
Ethan (smirks): "How much for the whole stall?"
Lily: "Not for sale. Not to men who think they can buy everything."
outline.emotionalShift: Amusement and challenge crackle; Lily puts up a wall, Ethan’s interest is piqued further.
outline.endingHook: Ethan lingers, clearly not planning to leave empty-handed.

outline.events: Ethan produces a fat stack of £50 notes, holds it out. Lily stares at it flatly, then shoves his hand away, grabbing apples instead.
outline.keyDialogue:
Lily: "Rich people think money fixes everything. Keep it. Some of us still have pride."
Narration (V.O.): "For the first time in his life, someone said no to Ethan Blackwood. And he couldn't stop thinking about her."
outline.emotionalShift: Ethan is stung yet fascinated; Lily’s irritation masks a flicker of intrigue.
outline.endingHook: Ethan watches Lily, persistent, as she ignores him.

outline.setting: Blackwood Tower office, night, rain blurring city lights.
outline.events: Ethan stands at his desk window, staring out at the rainy city. Harrison enters, folder in hand.
outline.keyDialogue:
Harrison: "Sir, the board has been waiting for an hour."
Ethan: "Let them wait. Harrison, find out one thing. Why does that market girl hate rich people so much?"
Harrison: (confused) "...Sir?"
outline.emotionalShift: Ethan’s obsession is revealed; Harrison is blindsided by his boss’s vulnerability.
outline.endingHook: Harrison leaves to investigate; Ethan’s gaze softens, lost in thought.

outline.events: Harrison returns, passing Ethan a file with an old photo inside. Ethan studies the faded image with regret.
outline.keyDialogue:
Harrison: "A wealthy developer took her father's farm. He died of heartbreak. She's supported her family alone ever since."
Ethan (quietly): "Then she'll never meet Ethan Blackwood."
Narration (V.O.): "So the billionaire made the craziest decision of his life. He decided to become... nobody."
outline.emotionalShift: Ethan is struck by empathy and guilt; resolves to hide his identity.
outline.endingHook: Ethan glances at the window, mind racing with a plan.

outline.events: Ethan returns, shivering under a worn hoodie, nervously approaches Lily’s stall. She eyes his soft hands with suspicion.
outline.keyDialogue:
Ethan: "Excuse me, miss. Got any work? I'm... unemployed."
Lily: (suspicious) "Your hands are far too soft for a labourer."
Ethan: "That's exactly why I'm unemployed."
Lily: (laughs) "Fine. Forty quid a day. Name?"
Ethan: "...Jack."
outline.emotionalShift: Guarded tension breaks as Lily laughs for the first time; a new dynamic is born.
outline.endingHook: Lily gestures 'Jack' to unload crates, side-eyeing his awkward stance.

outline.setting: Market, later that day, muddy and chaotic.
outline.events: Brief comedic montage: Ethan ('Jack') drops a crate, potatoes careen everywhere, he slips on a tomato, Lily suppresses laughter.
outline.keyDialogue:
Lily: "Jack, have you ever worked a single day in your life?"
Ethan (panting): "Not like this."
Narration (V.O.): "The man who signed billion-pound deals... was now losing a war against potatoes."
outline.emotionalShift: Humiliation gives way to shared amusement; Lily warms, Ethan feels alive.
outline.endingHook: They share a laugh as rain begins to pour again, huddling beneath the stall.

outline.setting: Market stall, dusk, rain thundering down.
outline.events: Ethan and Lily, soaked but close, huddle under a tarpaulin, sipping steaming tea from paper cups.
outline.keyDialogue:
Lily: "You've got nothing, Jack. So why do you smile so much?"
Ethan: "Maybe I've got more now than I ever had before."
Lily (blushing): "Strange answer."
Ethan: "Strange guy."
outline.emotionalShift: Playful banter softens into intimacy; Lily lets her guard down.
outline.endingHook: Lily looks away, hiding a smile as thunder rumbles; Ethan’s eyes linger on her.

outline.setting: Market, after closing. Neon lights reflected in puddles.
outline.events: Lily wipes down crates, pauses to study her father’s photo, tears brimming. Ethan sits beside her, hesitantly.
outline.keyDialogue:
Lily (voice trembling): "Rich people never see us, Jack. To them, we're just mud on their shoes. They took everything from my dad."
Ethan (guilt evident): "Not all of them are like that."
Lily: "All of them."
Narration (V.O.): "Every word she said... cut him like a knife."
outline.emotionalShift: Lily’s pain deepens; Ethan is wracked with guilt.
outline.endingHook: Ethan silently tries to comfort her, but her walls stay up.

outline.setting: Tower Bridge, night, rain misting, city lights sharp.
outline.events: Walking side by side, Lily shyly takes Ethan’s hand. She makes him promise not to turn cold like the wealthy.
outline.keyDialogue:
Lily: "Promise me you'll never become like them."
Ethan: "And what if... I already was?"
Lily: "Then I'd never forgive you." (She rests her head on his shoulder.)
Narration (V.O.): "He fell in love with her honesty. She fell in love with his lie."
outline.emotionalShift: Tenderness blooms, but Ethan’s guilt grows heavier.
outline.endingHook: Lily’s trust is complete, but Ethan can barely meet her gaze.

outline.setting: Market, next morning, sky bruised, bulldozers idle at the edge.
outline.events: Suits and workers descend; the market erupts in chaos. Lily stands in front of her stall, determined. Ethan stays frozen, pale. A developer shouts that Blackwood Group now owns the land.
outline.keyDialogue:
Developer: "Clear out! This land belongs to Blackwood Group now!"
Lily: "Over my dead body!"
Narration (V.O.): "Blackwood Group. His company. His name. And the truth was minutes away."
outline.outfits: Ethan: o2; Lily: o1; Harrison: o1 (appears from cars).
outline.emotionalShift: Crisis: Lily’s world threatened, Ethan’s two lives colliding.
outline.endingHook: Ethan’s secret teeters on the verge of exposure as Harrison arrives.

outline.setting: Market, chaos, black cars and neon glare.
outline.events: Harrison exits a car, addresses Ethan with deference as all eyes turn. Lily drops an apple, realization dawning as Ethan tries to reach her.
outline.keyDialogue:
Harrison: "Mr. Blackwood, shall I stop the project?"
Lily (turns): "...Blackwood? ...Ethan Blackwood?"
Ethan: "Lily, please, let me explain—"
Narration (V.O.): "The man she loved... was the man she hated most."
outline.outfits: Ethan: o2; Lily: o1; Harrison: o1.
outline.emotionalShift: Shock and heartbreak—Lily’s trust is shattered; Ethan’s secret explodes.
outline.endingHook: Tears glisten in Lily’s eyes as she stares at Ethan; the future uncertain—PART 2 coming soon.
